📖 LEARNED: Diplomatic Incident (Level 1). Trust builds 2x faster. You're TOO good though — once per week you can start a diplomatic incident: villagers argue, you pick the winner (+trust with them, -trust with the loser).

📖 Your hands remember: weave cloth (3 plant fiber — strip it from cleared brush), and build a Water Filter (cloth + charcoal from fire ashes). Dirty water doesn't have to stay dirty.

You wake up with dirt in your mouth and blood on your hands that isn't yours. The sky is the wrong color — not sunset-wrong, wound-wrong. Brunhilde Piotrowski. Comic shop owner. From Columbus, Ohio. That was yesterday. This is now. You have: Field suture kit, Beat-up Paperback, Photo album, Dispatcher's headset, Unnamed photograph. That's everything you own in this world. Haven. Twelve people.
